channel.title: Utrecht Beslist — City Council Decisions (Green & Climate)

item.title: Multi-Year Spatial Perspective 2026
item.description: The college of B and W proposes to the council to adopt the Multi-Year Spatial Perspective 2026. This perspective outlines how the municipality of Utrecht will deal with space in the coming years.

item.title: TAM Environmental Plan Jan van Galenstraat
item.description: The college of B and W proposes to the council to adopt the TAM Environmental Plan Jan van Galenstraat-Huizingalaan-Van Ginnekenlaan.
